title: Isometamidium chloride alters redox status, down-regulates p53 and PARP1 genes while modulating at proteomic level in Drosophila melanogaster.
authors: Dangabar Shadrack, Apollos; Garba, Auwalu; Samuel Ndidi, Uche; Aminu, Suleiman; Muhammad, Aliyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物异甲脒氯对果蝇的氧化应激和DNA损伤效应，仅含少量p53/PARP1蛋白的分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心体系，且无AI或MD方法。
abstract: As trypanocide, several side effects have been reported in the use of Isometamidium chloride. This study was therefore, designed to evaluate its ability to induce oxidative stress and DNA damage using D. melanogaster as a model organism. The LC(50) of the drug was determined by exposing the flies (1-3 days old of both genders) to six different concentrations (1 mg, 10 mg, 20 mg, 40 mg, 50 mg and 100 mg per 10 g of diet) of the drug for a period of seven days. The effect of the drug on survival (28 days), climbing behavior, redox status, oxidative DNA lesion, expression of p53 and PARP1 (Poly-ADP-Ribose Polymerase-1) genes after five days exposure of flies to 4.49 mg, 8.97 mg, 17.94 mg and 35.88 mg per 10 g diet was evaluated. The interaction of the drug in silico with p53 and PARP1 proteins was also evaluated. The result showed the LC(50) of isometamidium chloride to be 35.88 mg per 10 g diet for seven days. Twenty-eight (28) days of exposure to isometamidium chloride showed a decreased percentage survival in a time and concentration-dependent manner. Isometamidium chloride significantly (p < 0.05) reduced climbing ability, total thiol level, Glutathione-S-transferase, and Catalase activity. The level of H(2)O(2) was significantly (p < 0.05) increased. The result also showed significant (p < 0.05) reduction in the relative mRNA levels of p53 and PARP1 genes. The in silico molecular docking of isometamidium with p53 and PARP1 proteins showed high binding energy of -9.4 Kcal/mol and -9.2 Kcal/mol respectively. The results suggest that isometamidium chloride could be cytotoxic and a potential inhibitor of p53 and PARP1 proteins.
abstract_zh: 作为锥虫杀虫剂，使用盐酸异美他脒（Isometamidium chloride）时已报道多种副作用。因此，本研究旨在利用黑腹果蝇（D. melanogaster）作为模式生物，评估其诱导氧化应激和DNA损伤的能力。通过将果蝇（1-3日龄，雌雄兼有）暴露于六种不同浓度（每10克饲料含1 mg、10 mg、20 mg、40 mg、50 mg和100 mg）的药物中七天，测定了该药物的LC(50)。在果蝇暴露于每10克饲料含4.49 mg、8.97 mg、17.94 mg和35.88 mg的药物五天后，评估了药物对存活率（28天）、攀爬行为、氧化还原状态、氧化性DNA损伤、p53和PARP1（Poly-ADP-Ribose Polymerase-1）基因表达的影响。还评估了该药物与p53和PARP1蛋白的计算机模拟相互作用。结果显示，盐酸异美他脒的LC(50)为每10克饲料35.88 mg，持续七天。二十八（28）天暴露于盐酸异美他脒后，存活率百分比以时间和浓度依赖性方式下降。盐酸异美他脒显著（p < 0.05）降低了攀爬能力、总硫醇水平、谷胱甘肽-S-转移酶和过氧化氢酶活性。H(2)O(2)水平显著（p < 0.05）升高。结果还显示，p53和PARP1基因的相对mRNA水平显著（p < 0.05）降低。异美他脒与p53和PARP1蛋白的计算机模拟分子对接显示，结合能分别为-9.4 Kcal/mol和-9.2 Kcal/mol，表明高结合亲和力。结果表明，盐酸异美他脒可能具有细胞毒性，并可能是p53和PARP1蛋白的潜在抑制剂。
